headline: Tencent's hy4 sets an all-time record at 9.1% of tokens and climbs to No. 2
summary: Tencent's hy4-20261104 hit a fresh all-time high of 9.1% token share, and Tencent's provider share jumped 5.4 points in a day to 10.9%. DeepSeek still sits on top with 35.0%, though it gave back 8.6 points overnight.
highlights: tencent/hy4-20261104 climbed three spots to No. 2 and set a new all-time token-share record of 9.1%.
deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 remains No. 1 at 23.1% of tokens.
DeepSeek and Tencent together hold 45.9% of tokens, and adding Zhipu AI brings the top three to 53.9%.
stealth/crouton-alpha set its own all-time record at 3.3% and moved up three spots to No. 9.
New entrants: openai/gpt-6-astra-20260903 debuted at No. 47 and openai/gpt-5.6-sol-20260709 at No. 49.
Dropouts: upstage/solar-pro4-20260810 fell off from No. 45, and anthropic/claude-opus-5-20260723 fell off from No. 49.
